items.title: Carol Bash interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2012
items.q: I’m thrilled that there’s a black man in the White House, President Obama. I definitely have supported a lot of the initiatives that he’s put on the table.

ctx.x: Well here’s a purely opinion question on my part. It’s April 2012 and I’m wondering what’s your feeling about our country at the moment.

Wow. I’m kind of disheartened by what I hear as far as the politics are concerned, you know, just the level of animosity between what’s going on in our government, you know the republicans and the democrats and not being able to really come together and I think legislate for the populace, for the people. And of course I’m thrilled that there’s a black man in the White House, President Obama. I definitely have supported a lot of the initiatives that he’s put on the table. But I also am understanding that there is…

I think you’re right. It seems like the republicans in too much of the country have this added impetus to gain back the office, not just because they don’t like his policies, but because of what he is. It seems very troubling that three years ago we thought that there would be this bringing together, and instead it feels like it’s gone the other way.
